dialogues.speaker: Observe the Noctilucous Jade
dialogues.text: (Only Noctilucous Jade of radiant grade at the very least is acceptable for use in the Rite of Parting.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the Noctilucous Jade
dialogues.text: (Who'd have thought the hilichurls' cooking pot in Dadaupa Gorge would be a reliable means of assessing the quality...)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the kites
dialogues.text: (The seven kites used in the ceremony, which represent The Seven.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the kites
dialogues.text: #(How long before I find the one who took my {F#brother}{M#sister}?)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the censer
dialogues.text: (Everlasting Incense... The lengths we went to to get our hands on that.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the censer
dialogues.text: (I guess they'll burn it during the Rite of Parting...?)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the censer
dialogues.text: (It should be a spectacular sight... two million, nine-hundred-and-ninety thousand Mora's worth of incense, going up in smoke.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the perfume
dialogues.text: (A specially prepared perfume, made from a rare type of Silk Flower. It has a faint scent.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the perfume
dialogues.text: (Still, why would Rex Lapis go for the scent preferred by older women...)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the bell
dialogues.text: (A vital implement used in the Rite of Parting. The cleansing sound of the bell rids the deity of all impurities from the mortal world as it bids them farewell... Or something like that?)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the bell
dialogues.text: (It's hard to believe someone would store such a precious object in a teapot filled with cobwebs.)
